copy.headline: Largest enrollment drop in Texas’ recorded history means challenges for public schools, Morath says
copy.caption: Largest enrollment drop in Texas’ recorded history means challenges for public schools, Morath says. Texas lost about 135,000 students from last school year, outpacing pandemic-era declines, education commissioner Mike Morath said.
